premises.text: Crowd connectivity can connect IoT devices to the internet more efficiently and cost-effectively
premises.evidence_span: we could leverage cloud connectivity to connect more efficiently, more cost effectively, the next trillion things to the internet

premises.text: All network participants must be rewarded for participating
premises.evidence_span: if we could first make sure that everyone participating in the network would be rewarded

premises.text: Every connection must be safe and secure
premises.evidence_span: if we could make sure that every connection is safe and secure

premises.text: An economic model pays participants nodal cash for moving valuable data via smartphone IoT gateways
premises.evidence_span: the more data you move, the more value there is in the data you move, the more you earn nodal cash or cryptocurrency

premises.text: Rendezvous is a blockchain-based protocol that verifies device identity and can revoke compromised devices
premises.evidence_span: we created a communication protocol that has security built in. It's called Rendezvous

premises.text: Enterprise packaging covers asset tracking, sensor data collection, and connecting things to the internet
premises.evidence_span: They work for asset tracking, sensor data collection, or simply for connecting your things to the internet

premises.text: The solution is 100% software and addresses Industry 4.0 use cases via smartphone and partner distribution
premises.evidence_span: Nodal is the only solution which is 100% software and that addressed all the use cases in Industry 4.0

premises.text: Partnerships with smartphone makers, enterprise networking, and security firms extend the network
premises.evidence_span: we partnered with amazing companies like HTC, who basically pre-installed our app on their smartphones

value.text: A secure, rewarded crowd network that connects IoT things to the internet
value.evidence_span: a crowd-sourced connectivity solution to connect the next real things to the internet

secondary_value.text: Citizens reclaim ownership of data and earn for helping build a private IoT internet
secondary_value.evidence_span: reclaim ownership of their data and of the internet
